output.analysis: This is a reply from Raul Medina at Sabine Valve & Fitting, providing pricing and lead times for an RFQ sent by Ridgeline. However, this email is a vendor quote responding to our inquiry—it is not a customer request for us to quote, but rather a supplier quoting us. All line items come from the body of the new message. No items need to be extracted for Ridgeline to quote; this is information for our purchasing team. No headings or notes affect item extraction, and the quoted history is the original RFQ sent by Ridgeline to the vendor (not to be read for items). No review needed, as the vendor's reply is clear.
